text:
Anika: quick design review — I'm trying a compact first-run path that shows a stacked set of sample projects on the left and an inline progress indicator at the top. want feedback on copy + accessibility before i ship the variant. attaching screenshot (see preview link below). Jamal: looks promising. small concern: the progress text currently shows "2/3" and a visual pill. users might not get context — recommend a11y text for screen readers. Marta: agree with Jamal. prefer verbose SR text like "Step 2 of 3: pick a sample project". also banner CTA contrast is borderline on smaller screens. Anika: good calls. thinking of using visually-hidden text + readable visible label. quick snippet i'm proposing: ```
Step 2 of 3: pick a sample project 2 · Pick sample
``` that keeps the compact UI but reads clearly to SRs. what do you think about the visible copy — "Pick sample" vs "Choose sample project"? Jamal: i prefer "Choose sample project" (slightly clearer). also: can we avoid showing two toasts in quick succession? the success toast when a project loads then a tooltip is popping in — focus jumps. Evan: +1 on "Choose sample project". on the focus/toast issue — looks like the toast auto-focuses which defeats the modal focus trap. i'll file a follow-up bug to remove auto-focus from transient toasts. DesignBot: Preview deployed — https://console.redwood.dev/preview/onboard/1998882222-variant-c (team-only). please test on voiceover + talkback. Marta: i'll run axe + keyboard nav tonight and post results. quick nit: close icon on the sample picker banner has no aria-label — needs `aria-label="Close onboarding banner"`. Anika: perfect. i'll update copy to "Choose sample project", add the sr-only text, and remove toast autofocus. PR incoming; tagging @jamal @marta for final glance. :sparkles: Jamal: :thumbsup: thanks — if tests pass, go ahead to land today.
